title: Native point constant realizes the ordinary coefficient unit
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic and a normalized realization family $R$ [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. Let $s_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ be the model point, $U_s$ its actual derived forgetting functor including change to the specified algebraic closure and the section-module presentation, and $\Omega^W$ its native constant Weil complex in degree zero. Then $U_s(\Omega^W)\simeq R_s[0]$, where $R_s$ acts on itself by multiplication and is the native continuous locally finite-extension-valued coefficient ring. The target is exactly coefficientUnit in the recorded interface.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence, with the native-derived expansion of lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful.

proof.text: Use the algebraic-closure ring equivalence to make the middle Spec map in closureMap an isomorphism. The pullback map with identity outer legs is then an isomorphism. Native forgetting commutes with the degree-zero single functor, by mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor. Its underlying constant is definitionally AdicSheaf.unit.

The pushforward along closureMap is an exact equivalence. Apply singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso and adicLowerStarUnitIso, then the exact section-derived functor. The section presentation of the native regular coefficient module is definitionally the ordinary regular module, including its multiplication action. Apply mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor once more and singleFunctorIsoCompQ to identify the result with coefficientUnit.

proof_origin.place: Direct Lean proof by exact-derived single-functor comparisons, the existing native unit isomorphism and definitional regular-module presentation.

theorem native_exceptional_point_unit (R : Family l D) :
    Nonempty ((U D l R (point D)).obj (constant D l (point D)) ≅
      coefficientUnit D l R (point D))
